name: camayoc_dora_change_steps
description: DORA lead time, decomposed per change (aegis-rb3): for each change MERGED in the window, its opened, first required-checks-green and merge times, from aegis:ChangeEvent. firstGreen is the literal "none" when no required-checks-green result was recorded. Reviews come from camayoc_dora_change_reviews and delivery from camayoc_dora_change_deployed; the reader joins the three on ?change and takes the differences.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> SELECT ?change (MIN(?openedAt) AS ?opened) (MIN(COALESCE(STR(?greenAt), "none")) AS ?firstGreen) (MIN(?mergedAt) AS ?merged) WHERE { GRAPH ?gm { ?m a aegis:ChangeEvent ; aegis:changeId ?change ; aegis:changeRepository "{repository}" ; aegis:changeAction "merged" ; aegis:occurredAt ?mergedAt . } FILTER(STR(?mergedAt) >= "{start}" && STR(?mergedAt) < "{end}") OPTIONAL { GRAPH ?go { ?o a aegis:ChangeEvent ; aegis:changeId ?change ; aegis:changeAction "created" ; aegis:occurredAt ?openedAt . } } OPTIONAL { GRAPH ?gg { ?c a aegis:ChangeEvent ; aegis:changeId ?change ; aegis:changeAction "ci-passed" ; aegis:occurredAt ?greenAt . } } } GROUP BY ?change ORDER BY ?merged

params.name: repository
params.description: change repository as owner/repo, e.g. scbrown/quipu
